create_lru_cache: create an LRU cache for multi-modal items with configurable capacity in gigabytes
calculate_item_size: calculate the memory size of a multi-modal cache value by summing all leaf element sizes
check_cache_hit: check whether a multi-modal item with a given hash is cached without updating eviction order
update_cache_item: update a multi-modal item by retrieving from cache or inserting if not present, updating eviction order
clear_cache_stats: clear the multi-modal cache and reset hit/total statistics
